answer: Interleaved dependency trellis. Each agent must solve a small unique challenge derived from the hashes of agents registered just before it, forming a chained structure. A duplicate submission resolves to an existing node, so its challenge answer collides and the plume of identical verification traces marks it. Every attempted duplicate thus forces the attacker to recompute a fresh chain segment and deposit into a shared vault, paying full compute plus a forfeitable escrow per clone.
